name: Mutton curry (home-style Indian goat curry)

source.name: Swasthi's Recipes (indianhealthyrecipes.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 3. Mutton 500 g taken as raw goat meat (USDA game meat, goat, raw), all edible: the recipe allows bone-in, which would mean less meat per serving. Pressure-cooker version: 3/4 cup hot water = 180 g. Weights: 2 tbsp yogurt = 30 g, 3/4 tbsp ginger garlic paste split 5.5 g each, salt 3/4 tsp + 1/2 tsp = 7.5 g, meat masala 1 tsp + 2 tsp = 6 g (as curry powder), Kashmiri chilli 1/2 tsp = 1.3 g, 2 tbsp oil = 27 g, 3 cardamoms = 0.6 g, 1 inch cinnamon = 1 g (as ground cinnamon), 1 cup chopped onion = 160 g, 3/4 cup tomato = 135 g, 1.5 green chillies = 7.5 g, 1.5 tbsp coriander leaves = 1.5 g. Curry leaves left out. Assumed ~30% of meat weight, ~30% of onion and tomato, and ~40% of the water lost while cooking. A katori or bowl is taken as 1 cup, as everywhere in the catalog.
